clue.text: Architectural curve, wide maybe, diameter unusually large

parts.note: in cricket a wide is one kind of extra, a run not scored off the bat

explanation.walkthrough: 'Wide' looks like a description of the curve, but it is the cricket term for a ball bowled out of the batter's reach, which counts as an extra.
explanation.definitionFit: The extrados is the outer, upper curved surface of an arch, a technical term in building.
